title: Voice of the Green
description: The wells and greens around Crossroads have gone thin the same season a land spirit went quiet there, and Priestess Elara does not think that is a coincidence - a bound spirit does not tend what it cannot reach. As a Devotee, you can commune with what is left of it. Free it, and see whether the ground remembers how to grow again.

objectives.description: Find the trapped land spirit near Crossroads
Defeat the dark cultists holding the spirit captive
Gather natural offerings to restore the spirit (Moonleaf, Silvervine, Wildflowers)
Place the offerings and commune with the freed spirit
Report your success to Priestess Elara

notes: Threat: Crossroads' wells and greens have gone thin while the spirit has been bound - a stake tied to the land itself rather than a single named farmer this time. Giver motive: Elara's diagnosis links the two facts and sends a devotee to test it. Consequence: not wired; freeing the spirit is prose-only restoration.
